summary.name: ColorSet
summary.one_liner: ColorSet is a macOS app and ColorSetKit framework that lets developers manage dynamic interface colors, including Dark Mode support, on macOS versions back to 10.9.
keywords: adding dark mode to old apps
use_cases: Adding Dark Mode to a macOS app without dropping older macOS versions
Managing dynamic interface colors across macOS releases
Using Asset Catalog custom colors on macOS 10.13 and earlier
Supporting macOS 10.9 and later in a developer project
summary.what_it_does: ColorSet is a macOS tool built by iMazing's developers to add Dark Mode support to iMazing while keeping compatibility with older macOS versions. The page explains that Xcode 10's custom colors in Asset Catalogs only work for apps targeting macOS 10.13 and higher. ColorSet and its ColorSetKit framework give developers a unified way to manage dynamic interface colors, with stated support going down to macOS 10.9. The project is released under the MIT license.
notable: Brings Asset Catalog custom colors and Dark Mode support to macOS 10.9 and later
Built by iMazing developers to solve their own Dark Mode problem
caveats: Targets older macOS versions; the page does not describe features beyond color management
Page is brief and gives no installation or usage details
